findings.title: add_members requires :group_id but route provides :id
findings.body: In config/routes.rb the member routes are defined as delete/put "members" inside resources :groups, so the group id arrives as params[:id] (e.g. /admin/groups/:id/members). Admin::GroupsController#add_members does Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i) and #remove_member does the same. A real request from app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js which PUTs/DELETEs to /admin/groups/:id/members.json will raise ActionController::ParameterMissing for missing group_id. Controller specs pass only because they inject group_id directly, bypassing routing.

findings.title: remove_member requires :group_id but route provides :id
findings.body: Same mismatch as add_members: Admin::GroupsController#remove_member does Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i) while the route /admin/groups/:id/members supplies :id. DELETE requests from the admin UI will 400 with missing group_id, so member removal is broken in production despite the controller spec passing with an artificial group_id param.

findings.title: Unbounded limit/offset in members endpoint
findings.body: GroupsController#members does limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i and offset = params[:offset].to_i with no clamping, then group.users.order(...).limit(limit).offset(offset). An attacker can request limit=1000000 to load huge result sets into memory for DoS, or limit=0/negative or offset negative which can return empty sets or raise SQL errors. The previous code defaulted to 50/200 with limited use; the new code needs a max cap and offset >= 0 validation.

findings.title: totalPages off-by-one creates empty last page
findings.body: totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is exactly divisible by limit (e.g. 50/50, 100/50) this reports 2 and 3 pages instead of 1 and 2. Combined with next using Math.min(offset+limit, user_count), the UI can navigate to an offset == user_count that returns zero members, showing an empty last page and a wrong currentPage/totalPages label.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace around usernames
findings.body: add_members does usernames.split(",").each with no strip, then User.find_by_username(username). Input like "alice, bob" from the user-selector will look up " bob" with a leading space and silently skip it, so the second user is never added with no error. The action should strip each token and skip blanks.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of promise
findings.body: findMembers does if (Em.isEmpty(this.get('name'))) { return ; } whereas before it returned Ember.RSVP.resolve([]). Callers such as admin next/previous return group.findMembers() and routes rely on a thenable; returning undefined breaks promise chaining and error handling for empty-name groups. It should return a resolved promise.

findings.title: addMembers/removeMember swallow reload errors
findings.body: removeMember and addMembers do Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); }) without returning the inner findMembers promise and without a rejection handler. The outer promise resolves before the list reloads so the UI cannot wait for fresh data, and failures from the reload or from the 422 automatic-group guard are silently ignored with no user feedback.

findings.title: remove_member automatic-group test uses wrong verb
findings.body: The test for cannot remove members from automatic groups does xhr :put, :remove_member while the route is delete members => groups#remove_member. Controller specs dispatch by action name so it passes, but it never verifies the real DELETE route or the :id vs :group_id param mismatch, masking the production routing bug.
